title: Inversion with negative adverbials - Advanced emphatic structures

options.answer: Never I have seen such a beautiful sunset.
Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
Never I seen such a beautiful sunset.

explanation.en: After negative adverbials like 'never', we use inversion with auxiliary verb + subject + main verb.
explanation.ru: После отрицательных наречий как 'never' используется инверсия: вспомогательный глагол + подлежащее + основной глагол.
explanation.uz: Never kabi inkor qo'shimchalaridan keyin inversiya ishlatiladi: yordamchi fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l.

options.answer: Rarely does she complain about her work.

Rarely she complains about her work.

explanation.ru: С наречиями частотности как 'rarely' инверсия требует вспомогательного глагола 'does/do' + подлежащее + основной глагол.
explanation.uz: Rarely kabi chastota ravishlarida inversiya does/do yordamchi fe'li + ega + asosiy fe'l talab qiladi.

explanation.uz: Not only birinchi qismda inversiya talab qiladi: Not only + yordamchi fe'l + ega + fe'l.

items.text: The young entrepreneur Sarah Chen had always dreamed of running her own technology company, but never ___1___ she expected her startup to become so successful so quickly.
